title: Advanced C# Patterns & Modern .NET
description: Master async/await deep dives, memory management, dependency injection patterns, and advanced language features for production-grade applications.
longDescription: Go beyond basics to understand C# internals: async state machines, memory pools, Span<T>, ref structs, pattern matching enhancements, records, source generators, and how to design clean, testable architectures with DI containers.
whatYouLearn: Async/await internals and state machine behavior
Memory pooling and stack allocation techniques
Advanced DI patterns and service lifetimes
Source generators and compile-time code generation
Records, pattern matching, and functional-style C#
